title: Occupational injury records for treatment follow-up

F-R1.quote: To follow up the medical treatment of insured workers' occupational injuries in health facilities and settle their treatment costs with the Organization.

F-R2.quote: PDPL Article 15(3): disclosure requested by a public entity to implement another law, namely the Health Law.

F-R3.quote: Supervising the medical treatment provided in health facilities, a function given to the Ministry by the Health Law.

F-R4.quote: Worker name, national ID number, injury date, injury type, treating health facility.

F-R5.quote: Kept for five years after the related treatment case is closed, then destroyed.

F-R6.quote: Requested by the Ministry of Health from the General Organization for Social Insurance.

F-P1.quote: General Organization for Social Insurance, Data Management Office, privacy@gosi.example

F-P2.quote: Registering occupational injuries of insured workers, paying their compensation, and covering and following up their medical treatment with the Ministry of Health and health facilities.

F-P3.quote: Processing required to implement the Social Insurance Law.

F-P4.quote: Worker name, national ID number, employer establishment number, injury date, injury type, treating health facility, compensation paid.

F-P5.quote: Private-sector workers insured against occupational hazards who report an occupational injury.

F-P6.quote: The Ministry of Health, for following up the treatment of occupational injuries; other government entities where a law requires disclosure.

F-P7.quote: No transfer or disclosure outside the Kingdom.

F-P8.quote: Occupational injury records are kept for ten years after the final compensation is paid.
